value.title: Restart
value.synopsis: After a successful debut, the Breakers have their hands full with training new recruits and dealing with their conflicting personalities. Meanwhile, their self-appointed coach pressures Sho to confront his painful past.

value.title: Deformazione
value.synopsis: Tempers run high as the newly recruited, no-nonsense Hisashi clashes with his teammates over their lack of skills and commitment.

value.title: L'alba di un legame
value.synopsis: As the Breakers struggle to perfect their routine for the qualifiers, they debate whether to add even more difficult stunts, and Hisashi threatens to quit the team altogether.

value.title: Le lacrime del sole
value.synopsis: Kazuma suddenly stops coming to practice, and his teammates speculate wildly about the reason for his absence.

value.title: Quello che avrei voluto dirti
value.synopsis: The Breakers head to the qualifiers, but Haruki seems distracted by his sister’s troubles, while Sho struggles to deal with criticism from an old teammate.

value.title: Bittersweet Valentine
value.synopsis: As Valentine's Day approaches, Haruki attempts to repair his relationship with his sister, Haruko, but he has no idea where to start.

value.title: Cheer Boys!!
value.synopsis: On the eve of the National Cheerleading Championship, the Breakers receive an unexpectedly embarrassing opportunity for self-reflection.
